standard.title: Python Artifact Publication
standard.summary: Python publications preserve baseline wheel and source-distribution coverage and bind package contents, metadata and evidence to each promoted file.
standard.fitness-role: Experimental Python profile; not an approved gate
applies-to: Python package index and exchange operators

requirements.override-explanation: Specializes upstream file inventory and checksums for wheels and sdists, retaining every required baseline role and compatibility variant; producer declarations cannot waive missing files.
requirements.text: Producers must retain the exact baseline distribution inventory and publish patched counterparts of every required wheel variant, sdist and companion role with checksums, preserving runtime, ABI and platform coverage and public import and entry-point behavior.

checks.override-explanation: Evaluates Python distribution roles and compatibility coverage while retaining the parent's inventory completeness and checksum obligations.
checks.title: Required Python distributions and compatibility coverage are preserved

requirements.text: Packaged tracked sources must match the patched commit through an explicit mapping; generated or transformed files must have individually recorded digests, source inputs and generating commands, without disguising tracked-source mismatches.

checks.title: Packaged source and generated-file origins are accounted for

requirements.text: Distribution archives, embedded identity metadata, index file references and advertised hashes or separate core metadata must consistently describe the exact evaluated and promoted bytes; unsafe or ambiguous archive entries must be rejected.

checks.title: Archives and index metadata identify the evaluated distribution bytes

requirements.text: Producers must compare baseline and patched dependency, runtime, import, namespace-package, entry-point and license metadata and behavior, disclose intended changes and validate them for every declared supported environment without silently narrowing baseline support.

checks.title: Python metadata changes and import compatibility are validated
